title: Rabo Mobiel Identificeren
meta_description: Rabo Mobile Identification: Simply identify yourself at Rabobank
full_description: Identify yourself easily with the Rabo Mobile Identification App. So it is no longer necessary to go to your local bank. All you need is a valid ID and this app.When do you use the Rabo Mobile Identification App?- If you want to request an account as a private customer- If you are 18 years old and already have an account with Rabobank- If you have received a code to confirm a joint account- If you have received a code to identify yourself
